Subject: MSA + Order Form redlines — publicity & logo use questions

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Attached are our proposed redlines to the MSA and the Order Form; we focused comments in two buckets that came up on the call: (1) confidentiality/DSR handling and (2) publicity and logo use (case studies, press releases, badge/partner page).

A few specific asks so we can converge quickly:
- Can you confirm whether OmniData requires a blanket prohibition on logo use, or if case-study/press release approvals are sufficient?
- On quote approvals: you mentioned legal wants sign-off before any customer quote — is a 5 business day review window acceptable?
- For embargoes: do you need a formal embargo window in the contract (e.g., 14 days), or prefer to handle on a per-announcement basis via email?

We'd like to keep publicity permissions narrow but usable — e.g., explicit approval for logo files and a brief, 3–5 business day approval window for quotes. If OmniData needs a longer review period we can accommodate but will need to map that to our go-to-market timelines.

I’ve attached: MSA_Redline_v2.pdf and OrderForm_Redline_v2.pdf (redlines visible), and our brand_guidelines.pdf for reference on intended logo use.

If it helps, I can loop in Laura from Legal and Ben from Brand Ops to resolve the publicity language in one pass.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez

Diego —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redlines. Our legal team reviewed and prepared a counter-redline focused on publicity scope; I’ve attached (OmniData_redline_legal.pdf). High-level summary:

- Publicity: OmniData is comfortable with customer case studies and joint press releases but wants explicit approval before any public announcement. Our counsel prefers an express carve-out limiting "publicity" to case studies and press releases only (no implicit reference rights for marketing collateral).
- Logo use: OmniData requests that logo use be limited to instances where an approved asset is provided and approval is obtained. No general license to reproduce the logo beyond an approved asset and placement (partner page, case study).
- Quote approvals & embargo: Legal is proposing a 10 business day review window for any quote or excerpt that will be used in a press release; embargo handling should be explicit (OmniData prefers 14 days to coordinate press teams).
- Data/DSR/SOC2: also flagged a request for our SOC 2 report and a clause clarifying subject access requests routing.

Can you share Redwood's position? If your legal/brand teams can provide a consolidated counter (especially on logo scope and timing), that will help us move to a clean-signature stage.

Best,
Claire Jenkins
Senior Counsel, OmniData
Claire.Jenkins@omnidata.com

Attachment: OmniData_redline_legal.pdf (pdf)

Laura / Ben —

Forwarding OmniData's legal redlines (attached). They tightened publicity to only case studies & press releases, require approved assets for logo use, and want a 10-business-day quote approval plus a 14-day embargo option. Also asked for SOC2 and DSR routing language.

My read: we can accept case-study + press release carveout but should push back on the 10-business-day quote window (that materially affects our marketing timelines). Proposed counter from my side:
- Keep publicity scoped to case studies and press releases (ok).
- Logo use: accept requirement for approved assets, but preserve a small, explicit right to use a compact partner badge on our public partner page without separate approval each time.
- Quotes: propose 3 business days for marketing quote approvals; if the customer needs additional time we can extend to 5 for press releases only.
- Embargo: offer 14 days only for large joint announcements; otherwise allow per-announcement coordination.

Can Legal confirm if 3 business days for quotes is defensible? Ben, can Brand Ops accept a partner page badge usage clause (we'd include the badge in brand_guidelines.pdf and require that OmniData confirm compliance)?

Thanks —
Diego

Claire / Diego / Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary, Claire. Redwood's consolidated position below (tracking edits attached in MSA_Redline_v2.pdf & OrderForm_Redline_v2.pdf):

- Publicity scope: Agree to restrict publicity rights to \"case studies\" and \"joint press releases\" and require written approval prior to publication. We insert a definition that excludes testimonials used in marketing unless separately approved.
- Logo use: OmniData will provide an approved logo asset; Redwood is permitted to use that asset for (a) case study collateral, (b) joint press releases, and (c) a compact partner badge on Redwood's partner directory and sales materials. The badge is pre-approved by OmniData once placed per the provided brand_guidelines.pdf. Any other logo uses require separate written approval.
- Quote approvals: We will accept a 5 business day approval window for press releases and a 3 business day approval for case study excerpts / customer quotes used in non-press collateral. If OmniData needs a longer window on a specific release they should state so at the time of notice.
- Embargos: Accept 14-day embargo for enterprise-wide joint announcements; otherwise handled case-by-case.
- SOC2 & DSR: We will provide a SOC 2 summary and a routing contact for data subject requests; full attestations will be available under NDA/secure transfer.

Claire — if that aligns with OmniData's needs, we can produce a clean MSA + Order Form for signature and send the Order Form via DocuSign. I attached the updated redlines for visibility and included the brand badge file in brand_guidelines.pdf.

Next steps suggested:
1) Claire confirms acceptance of the partner badge approach and the 3/5 business day split for approvals.
2) Once confirmed, we move to clean signature pages (I will kick off DocuSign for the Order Form).

Happy to hop on a 20–30m call if any of the timing items need real-time negotiation.

Regards,
